scope: Only source-review production module plus new author test/evidence. No money parser, currency, range, schema, frozen artifacts, ROOT or CODE written.

implementation.shared_detection_view: Existing supported rate logic uses same NFKC/Cf/horizontal-space/traditional detection copy; raw text and CP offsets unchanged.
implementation.unsupported_prefix: Explicit 每 or 按 followed by 年/年度/周/週/星期/季度/季/次/分钟/分鐘/秒/公里/人/班. Only existing finite 标准/约定/为/是/计/共/合计/基本工资/工资/薪酬/薪资/金额/人民币/RMB/CNY/symbol connectors may occur before the anchored amount.
implementation.layout: Only explicit incomplete rate prefix may cross whitespace/line/block layout. Sentence/commas and intervening subject or prose cannot be crossed. A literal supplied subject ending 每周/按年/每季度 does not create a denominator.
implementation.availability: After existing currency/range/qualifier/arithmetic/truncation checks, unsupported prefix gives amount null and normalization unsupported regardless of valid model rate/total attributes; never mapped to a supported enum.
implementation.preservation: Original representation/raw/value/quote/source/CP and stored history/state remain unchanged; read-time historical exact can downgrade; prior null never auto-upgrades.
